function.name: debugstr_imn
function.description: This function returns a string representation of a WPARAM value, which represents a specific command or action in the IMN (Input Method Manager) system.

parameters.name: wparam
parameters.description: This parameter represents a specific command or action in the IMN system.

function.return_type: char: This return type represents a string corresponding to the WPARAM value passed to the function.

function.name: debugstr_imc
function.description: This function returns a string representation of the WPARAM wparam based on the switch case.

parameters.name: wparam
parameters.description: This parameter is used to determine the string representation to return.

function.return_type: char: The function returns a string representation of the WPARAM wparam.

function.name: input_context_get_comp_str
function.description: This function retrieves a composition string from an input context, either the result string or the composition string depending on the 'result' parameter. It also returns the length of the string.

parameters.name: ctx
parameters.description: Pointer to the input context from which to retrieve the composition string

parameters.name: result
parameters.description: Flag indicating whether to retrieve the result string (if TRUE) or the composition string (if FALSE)

parameters.name: length
parameters.description: Pointer to a variable that receives the length of the retrieved string

function.return_type: WCHAR *; Pointer to the retrieved string, or NULL if the function fails

function.name: input_context_set_comp_str
function.description: This function resizes, locks, and sets the composition string in the input context. It also handles the composition string attributes and clauses.
function.return_type: void, this function does not return anything

function.name: input_context_select_ui_font
function.description: This function selects a UI font from an input context and a device context.

parameters.name: ctx
parameters.description: Pointer to an input context from which the UI font is selected.

parameters.name: hdc
parameters.description: Handle to a device context where the selected font will be used.

function.return_type: HFONT, represents the selected UI font. If the font cannot be selected, it returns NULL.

function.name: ime_send_message
function.description: This function sends a message to the Input Method Editor (IME). It locks the input context, resizes the input context message buffer if necessary, locks the message buffer, creates a new message with the provided parameters, and adds it to the buffer. Finally, it unlocks the message buffer and the input context, and generates the message.
function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value.

function.name: ime_set_composition_status
function.description: This function sets the composition status of the Input Method Editor (IME). It locks the IMC and IMCC, checks the composition status, and sets the message accordingly. It then unlocks the IMC and IMCC, and returns the message.

parameters.name: composition
parameters.description: Boolean value representing the composition status to be set

function.return_type: UINT, represents the message that indicates the start or end of composition in IME. Returns 0 if the IMC cannot be locked.

function.name: ime_ui_paint
function.description: This function is responsible for painting the UI of the Input Method Editor (IME). It handles the painting process based on the input context, the composition form style, and the position of the IME window.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: Handle to the window where the painting is performed.

function.return_type: void, as this function does not return any value.

function.name: ime_ui_update_window
function.description: This function updates the window based on the input context. If the input context string is empty or null, the window is hidden. Otherwise, the window is shown without activating it and the window is redrawn.

parameters.name: ctx
parameters.description: The input context used to get the composition string.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: Handle to the window that needs to be updated.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return anything.

function.name: ime_ui_composition
function.description: This function locks the input context, updates the window with the context, and then unlocks the input context. It returns early if the lparam argument has the GCS_RESULTSTR flag set or if the input context cannot be locked.

parameters.name: lparam
parameters.description: Parameter that may contain various types of data. If it has the GCS_RESULTSTR flag set, the function will return early.

function.return_type: void, meaning this function does not return a value.

function.name: ime_ui_start_composition
function.description: This function starts the composition of the Input Method Editor User Interface. It locks the input context, updates the window, and then unlocks the input context.
function.return_type: void, this function does not return anything.

function.name: ime_set_comp_string
function.description: This function is used to set the composition string in the Input Method Editor (IME). It locks the input context, converts the virtual-key messages into character messages, resizes and locks the input context message buffer, copies the messages into the buffer, unlocks the buffer, increments the message count, unlocks the input context, and generates a message.
function.return_type: UINT, represents the number of messages generated by the function. If the function fails, it returns 0.

function.name: ime_ui_notify
function.description: This function handles different cases based on the value of wparam and returns the result of the corresponding function call.
function.return_type: LRESULT, represents the result of the function call based on the case evaluated in the switch statement

function.name: ime_ui_window_proc
function.description: This function processes window messages for the IME user interface.
function.return_type: LRESULT, the result of the message processing and depends on the message sent.

function.name: ImeInquire
function.description: This function initializes the IME (Input Method Editor) user interface class, sets up the IMEINFO structure, and registers the class.

parameters.name: info
parameters.description: Pointer to an IMEINFO structure that receives information about the IME.

parameters.name: ui_class
parameters.description: Pointer to a string that receives the name of the user interface class for the IME.

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: A set of bit flags that specify properties of the IME. The flags are not used in the function.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the function successfully initializes the IME user interface class and sets up the IMEINFO structure. Otherwise, it returns FALSE.

function.name: ImeDestroy
function.description: This function unregisters a class and returns a boolean value.

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: This parameter is used in the TRACE function to log the force value.

function.return_type: BOOL, represents the success or failure of the function. In this case, it always returns TRUE.

function.name: ImeSelect
function.description: This function locks the input context, sets the open status to false, and if possible, locks the IMCC, sets the memory to zero, and then unlocks the IMCC. Finally, it unlocks the IMC and returns true.

parameters.name: select
parameters.description: Boolean value to determine if the function should proceed or return true immediately.

function.return_type: BOOL, represents whether the function was successful or not. Returns TRUE if successful, FALSE otherwise.

function.name: ImeSetActiveContext
function.description: This function is a stub that currently only returns TRUE. It is intended to set the active context for the Input Method Editor (IME).

parameters.name: flag
parameters.description: Boolean flag to set the context

function.return_type: BOOL, represents the success or failure of setting the active context. Currently always returns TRUE.

function.name: ImeProcessKey
function.description: This function processes a key input for the Input Method Editor (IME). It locks the input context, sends a message to the IME driver, then unlocks the input context.
function.return_type: BOOL. Returns TRUE if the function successfully processes the key. Returns FALSE otherwise.

function.name: ImeToAsciiEx
function.description: This function is used to convert the input from an Input Method Editor (IME) to ASCII. It handles the composition of characters and messages from the IME.

parameters.name: vkey
parameters.description: Virtual-key code of the key that generated the input

parameters.name: vsc
parameters.description: Scan code of the key that generated the input

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Pointer to the 256-byte array of keyboard state

parameters.name: msgs
parameters.description: Pointer to a structure that receives the translated messages

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Specifies whether the key is up or down, and whether the key is an extended key

function.return_type: UINT, represents the number of messages generated by the input
